text.en:
Today you learn three helper words.
Can: you are able to.
I can swim.
Should: it is a good idea.
We should leave soon.
Must: you have no choice.
You must wear a helmet.

These words never change.
He can come today. She should call the office.
The next word stays short: no s.
To ask, put the helper word first.
Can I sit here? Should I book in advance?
To say no, add not.
You must not touch the cable.

You will ask for help politely, and give advice.
Can you say that again?
Have to means the rules ask you.
We have to show our tickets.
Do not have to means you may skip it.
You do not have to print the ticket.
